Visa regime for entering Serbia
VISA REGIME
For holders of diplomatic and official passports:
No visas required
For holders of ordinary passports and other travel documents:
No visas required for visits of up to 90 days within a 6 months period
The Protocol between the Government of the Republic of Serbia and the Government of the United Arab Emirates on the amendments to the Agreement between the Government of the Republic of Serbia and the Government of the United Arab Emirates on the exemption of visas for holders of diplomatic and official/special passports, signed in New York on 26 September 2018, entered into force on 12 May 2019.
Under the Protocol, nationals of either State, holders of diplomatic, official, special, ordinary and service passports, and members of diplomatic and consular missions, other than those in the territory of the State of the other Party, shall enter, exit, transit and stay in the territory of the other Party without a visa and free of charge, for a period not exceeding ninety (90) days, through border posts for international passenger traffic.
